   274	def score_adapter_on_draw(adapter: Path | None, side: Path, out: Path, chunk: int = 32,
   275	                          rows: list[dict] | None = None, extra_args: list[str] = ()) -> dict:
   276	    """The trainer's evaluate_qlora over a frozen page draw, in chunks of ``chunk`` pages with
   277	    card 0 checked before each (#396), resumable (a chunk whose readings exist is skipped).
   278	    Returns the trainer's numbers summed over chunks and wsp.pages metrics on all readings."""
   279	    from wsp import pages, vlm_reference
   280	    from wsp.lora_subject import _wait_for_card
   281	    rows = rows if rows is not None else load(side / "pages.jsonl")
   282	    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   283	    for i in range(0, len(rows), chunk):
   284	        stem = out / f"chunk-{i // chunk:03d}"
   285	        if stem.with_suffix(".raw.jsonl").exists():
   286	            continue
   287	        _wait_for_card(24 * 3600)
   288	        draw = stem.with_suffix(".draw.jsonl")
   289	        draw.write_text("".join(json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n" for r in rows[i:i + chunk]), encoding="utf-8")
   290	        argv = ["--pages", str(draw), "--data-root", str(side), "--report", str(stem.with_suffix(".json"))]
   291	        argv += (["--adapter", str(adapter)] if adapter else []) + list(extra_args)
   292	        if vlm_reference.main(argv) != 0:
   293	            raise RuntimeError(f"evaluate_qlora failed on {stem.name}; nothing recorded")

   182	        path = Path(path)
